title: Exact countable products on a specified small pro-etale model
statement: Let C be a small category in universe u, J a Grothendieck topology on C, T a scheme in any universe, and e an equivalence from C to the pro-etale site of T [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Assume J is the topology induced along e from the pro-etale topology. For every u-small sheaf R of commutative rings, the category of u-small R-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] has exact countable products. No relation between the universe of T and u is imposed beyond the displayed equivalence.

source.place: (1), exact countable products on the chosen small pro-etale model

proof.text: Transport the ring sheaf and module sheaves along the given equivalence of sites. Lift coefficient rings and modules to a common universe if necessary. Universe lifting preserves countable products and preserves and reflects local surjectivity, hence epimorphisms of module sheaves. Apply exact countable products on the full pro-etale site to the lifted ring and maps, then reflect the resulting product epimorphism back to the small universe. Products are left exact in an abelian category, so preservation of epimorphisms implies the asserted exactness instance. The same argument includes empty sites and zero rings.

theorem smallProEtaleExactProducts {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (T : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{t})
    (e : C ≌ T.ProEt)
    (hJ : J = e.functor.inducedTopology (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology T))
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) :
    HasExactLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ) (ringedSiteModules.{u} (ringSheaf R))
